title: Left step when the right list ends
statement: Let $l$ and $r$ be lists of integers and let $i,j$ be natural numbers with $i<|l|$ and $|r|\le j$. Merging the tail of $l$ beginning at index $i$ with the tail of $r$ beginning at index $j$ gives the $i$th entry of $l$ followed by the merge of the tail of $l$ beginning at $i+1$ with that same tail of $r$.
